title: HapCiD: Detecting API-related Compatibility Issues in OpenHarmony Apps
abstract: arXiv:2609.20099v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: OpenHarmony, an emerging open-source mobile platform, is rapidly gaining attention in the mobile development community. Its fast-evolving Software Development Kit (SDK) introduces numerous Application Programming Interfaces (APIs) to boost developer productivity but inevitably introduces compatibility challenges, an issue well known from platforms like Android. However, existing compatibility analysis tools are ineffective for OpenHarmony due to its newly introduced ArkTS programming language and the lack of a mature behavioral model to capture app execution semantics. To bridge this gap, we present HapCiD, an open-source tool for automatically detecting API-related compatibility issues in OpenHarmony apps. Applied to 4,478 apps, HapCiD successfully detects 2,040 compatibility issues across 163 apps with 100 percent accuracy. translated_title: HapCiD：检测OpenHarmony应用中与API相关的兼容性问题
translated_abstract: OpenHarmony（开源鸿蒙）是一个新兴的开源移动平台，正迅速受到移动开发社区的关注。其快速演进的软件开发工具包（SDK）引入了大量应用程序编程接口（API）以提升开发者的生产力，但不可避免地也带来了兼容性挑战，这一问题在Android等平台上早已为人所知。然而，由于OpenHarmony采用了新引入的ArkTS编程语言，且缺乏能够捕捉应用执行语义的成熟行为模型，现有的兼容性分析工具对其并不有效。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了HapCiD，一个用于自动检测OpenHarmony应用中API相关兼容性问题的开源工具。应用于4,478个应用后，HapCiD以100%的准确率成功检测出163个应用中的2,040个兼容性问题。基于这些发现，我们对兼容性问题进行了全面研究，对其类型进行了分类考察。
tldr: 本文提出了开源工具HapCiD，利用ArkTS分析和应用行为建模，以100%的准确率自动检测OpenHarmony应用中与API相关的兼容性问题，在4,478个应用中检测出163个应用存在的2,040个兼容性问题。
